title: Don't Blame Me
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: University student Toshiaki Kaji joins a college film club and falls for its awkward member Ikurou Nakamura; their relationship runs over years into adult life (ANN, MU). A frame story follows Kaji's 13-year-old cousin Makoto, who learns his admired cousin is gay (ANN, AniList). Two volumes of comedy and drama.
life_message: Love takes patience and continued effort, and a free life means refusing to settle for a dull one.

content.note: Adult college couples; a club member secretly films two characters having sex and it is screened at a festival (ANN); MU Dubious Consent, Incest (half-brothers Kujirai and Takasaki, ANN).
Secret filming of sex played as comedy (ANN).
